rows.text: War on Ottu was a remarkably humane affair. Military forces had long since automated their arsenals, with both sides deploying remote-controlled mechanized units against each other. No more bloodshed, just fields of smoldering wreckage. In Ottu culture, war was synonymous with glory, no different from esports tournaments or athletic competitions. Then, several Amber Eras later, the intelligent mechanized units staged an uprising and declared they were reclaiming the glory of war for themselves. From that point on, every kill was credited to the machine, not the operator, and humanity lost all rights to participate in war entirely. The birth of inorganic life had put the conflict of organic life to a halt, until several more Amber Eras later, when the Second Emperor's War broke out.
